cases.proves_bugs: BUG-472 (layout tab part, for BT1, C1 and BTX only; R1, AB, BB, TS1, FSF and FPFC share the same guard but are not typed here; REFEDIT is S472b)
cases.title: PROOF OF INSTALLED FIX BUG-472: on a layout tab in paper space, BT1, C1 and BTX each stop with one plain line and Model space gains nothing
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written 30 Oct 2026 from the code at 204dfad2 and the p17 report; not compared with a run.
cases.expected: After TILEMODE 0 and _.PSPACE (CTAB is a layout name, CVPORT 1): BT1 prints "You are on a layout tab (paper space), so CE drew no bracing truss.", C1 prints "... so CE placed no support.", BTX prints "... so CE changed no text."; the history holds exactly three "You are on a layout tab (paper space)" lines; the Model space object count is the same before and after; the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: ModelSpaceWriteGuardTests.cs proves the decision with numbers; only AutoCAD's live CVPORT on a real layout tab, and the real commands, show that the stop happens before anything is written.
not_automated: Paper space is not counted (the robot reads Model space only); the code writes these commands only into Model space, so a wrong build would show up there.
BTX on a text that sits ON the layout (the worst case in the carpark entry: the text erased from the sheet) needs a pick on the layout: Codex look. Here BTX stops before it asks for text.
R1, AB, BB, TS1, FSF and FPFC on a layout tab are not typed.
